# Unknown task marker fixture

- [ ] Open task
- [/] In-progress task
- [x] Completed task
- [X] Completed task (capital X)
- [>] Migrated task
- [<] Scheduled task
- [-] Dropped task
- [w] Waiting-for task
- [W] Waiting-for task (capital W)
- [?] Unknown custom marker (question mark)
- [!] Unknown custom marker (bang, e.g. "important" in some Obsidian setups)
- [i] Unknown custom marker (lowercase i, "info" in some setups)
